'''September 2001 Madrid tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madrid, Spain on 8 September 2001. [[Angel San Jose]] won it. It is known from Heraclio Sanchez's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2951">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-ithor-madrid-08-sept-01d2951/ ithor-madrid-08-sept-01], DeckTech (Heraclio "Morgoth" Sanchez, 10 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-ithor-madrid-08-sept-01d2951/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Madrid, Spain
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Angel San Jose]]
